$comment: The one owner of every GitHub secret and variable the workflows read: its GitHub scope, the local source `node scripts/workspace.mjs secrets push` copies it from, and which release.yml stage needs it. release/github-secrets.mjs reads this file for workspace.mjs and .github/scripts/release-secrets.sh. scope: repository-secret | repository-variable | release-secret | release-variable (the `release` GitHub Environment). local: a config.ini section and key, or a keys/ file (base64 when encoded is set). release: the first release.yml stage that needs it (prepare: every run, release: signed runs), with an optional platform. dependabot: also set as a Dependabot secret when `secrets push --dependabot` runs. retired: names an earlier layout created that `secrets check` reports and `secrets push --prune` deletes.

items.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
items.purpose: Cloudflare account id for every R2 bucket and the site Workers; not a secret

items.name: BPP_GAME_LIBS_TOKEN
items.purpose: read-only Cloudflare API token limited to the bazaarplusplus-game-libs bucket; checks.yml mod lane

items.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
items.purpose: operator Cloudflare API token with R2 read and write on bppinstaller, bazaarplusplus-game-libs and the metrics bucket; mod::fetch and release::upload

items.name: TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY
items.purpose: Tauri updater signing key, both platforms

items.name: APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY
items.purpose: Developer ID Application identity name; macOS codesign

items.name: APPLE_API_ISSUER
items.purpose: App Store Connect API issuer id; macOS notarization

items.name: APPLE_API_KEY
items.purpose: App Store Connect API key id; macOS notarization

items.name: APPLE_API_KEY_P8
items.purpose: App Store Connect API private key; macOS notarization

items.name: APPLE_CERTIFICATE
items.purpose: Developer ID Application certificate with its private key, exported from Keychain Access as .p12; imported into the runner keychain
